Today’s M&A briefing — 16 deals, the strategies behind them · 6 November 2026

🔹 Bekaert (metallic wire transformation and reinforcement solutions) acquires Dextra (reinforcement systems) — €140m.
Dextra generated €118 M in revenue and €20 M in EBITDA in 2025. It is rooted in Southeast Asia and South Asia, markets where seismic standards drive growing demand for mechanical connection solutions. Closing expected in H1 2027.

🔹 21CC Group (event production — creative design, audiovisual) acquires SkyShows (swarm drone shows for events) — £2.1m.

🔹 Autoneum acquires Trèves.

🔹 TIM (italian telecoms operator, Telecom Italia) takes a stake in VoiSmart (italian publisher of proprietary solutions).

🔹 GeFiL (filiale de Safety21) (digital solutions for enforcement and road safety) acquires Smartprise Italia (cross-border recovery of road sanctions and unpaid highway tolls from foreign drivers, proprietary SaaS platform).

🔹 TSC Real Estate (fonds TSC Ambulante Gesundheitsimmobilien 01) (berlin-based asset manager specializing) acquires Haus der Gesundheit, Stuttgart-Feuerbach (13,000 m² medical center leased to 19 tenants).

🔹 Mistral AI (artificial intelligence model development, France) acquires SkipLabs (tools to make AI code generation faster).

🔹 BPD Europe (real estate development) acquires Blauwhoed (real estate development).

🔹 Elca (IT group, Vaud, Switzerland) acquires Löwenfels Partner (software publisher for social insurance).

🔹 IHM (hotel group, over 80 hotels and nearly 7,500 rooms in France, already present in Lyon with about ten establishments) acquires Marriott Lyon Cité Internationale (4-star hotel with 204 rooms located near the Congress Center and Parc de la Tête-d'Or, Lyon — property and business assets).

🔹 Quality Guard Belgium (allergen management, labeling) acquires BetterLife (standardization of ingredient, allergen).

🔹 IDDS (spatial development consultancy, Netherlands) acquires Lodewijck Groep (legal services in territorial development sector).

🔹 247 Watersnijden (waterjet cutting, Netherlands) acquires AllesWatersnijden (AWS) (waterjet cutting, De Lier, Netherlands).

🔹 Henk Netten Metaalhandel (metal recycling and trading, Stellendam) acquires Gebr. van Dooren Metaalhandel (metal recycling and trading, Middelharnis).

🔹 De Haas Road Cargo (transport of flowers and floriculture products) acquires Tijsterman Transporteurs (transport of flowers and floriculture products).

🔹 Genetics Consolidated (international bovine breeding programs and artificial insemination services) acquires KI Samen (sale of semen from various bovine breeds).

en.text:
Today’s fundraising briefing — 4 deals, the strategies behind them · 6 November 2026

🔹 Alethio Therapeutics (development of ATX-011, an antibody targeting the G6B protein to treat myeloproliferative neoplasms, chronic blood cancers) — $90m · Series A.
Alethio Therapeutics was founded in late 2021.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Sofinnova Partners and RA Capital (co-leads); Oxford Science Enterprises (founding investor); Cancer Research Horizons; University of Oxford.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Essential thrombocythemia has been treated for decades with molecules (hydroxyurea, interferon, anagrelide) that control symptoms without addressing the cells that perpetuate the disease.

🔹 VÆRIDION (development of the Microliner) — €30m · Series A2.
VÆRIDION was also selected for a €94.5 M grant from the European Commission's Innovation Fund (CAROLUS program) to finance a final assembly line in Oberpfaffenhofen — a conditional grant awaiting agreement signature expected in 2027.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Construction of the first compliant prototype, propulsion and battery bench tests, wind tunnel tests.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: SHIFT Invest and Invest-NL (co-leads); World Fund, Project A, Vsquared Ventures (existing); Alexander Rittweger, founder of PAYBACK.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: The setup — equity for engineering, public grant for industrialization — is the standard structure for electric aircraft programs in Europe, as the two phases have very different risk and duration profiles that private funders cannot absorb alone.

🔹 Green Voltis (optimization and commercialization of flexible energy storage assets in Europe) — €13.5m · Series A.
Green Voltis manages over 1.2 GWh of contracted and operational storage.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Lochpine Capital (sole investor).
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: The pivot to Power-to-Compute applies the same skill — predicting prices, arbitrating between markets, optimizing in real-time — to a client whose power demand is structurally growing and whose tolerance for tariff unpredictability is low.

🔹 ArmorCheck (non-destructive testing of ballistic protection — detection of invisible internal damage in ceramic plates of individual equipment) — €1m.
ArmorCheck has already made two hires and plans three additional hires in 2027. The company solves a concrete problem: a ballistic plate can be weakened by an impact or fall without visible damage, making replacement decisions uncertain.

Levées de fonds : les 4 opérations chiffrées de l'édito du 6 novembre 2026.

🔹 Alethio Therapeutics (𝑑𝑒́𝑣𝑒𝑙𝑜𝑝𝑝𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑑'𝐴𝑇𝑋-011, 𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑐𝑜𝑟𝑝𝑠 𝑐𝑖𝑏𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑙𝑎 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑡𝑒́𝑖𝑛𝑒 𝐺6𝐵 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑟 𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑛𝑒́𝑜𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑠𝑚𝑒𝑠 𝑚𝑦𝑒́𝑙𝑜𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑙𝑖𝑓𝑒́𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑓𝑠) — 90 M$ · Série A.
Alethio Therapeutics a été fondée fin 2021.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : Sofinnova Partners et RA Capital (co-leads) ; Oxford Science Enterprises (investisseur fondateur) ; Cancer Research Horizons ; Université d'Oxford.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : La thrombocythémie essentielle est traitée depuis des décennies par des molécules (hydroxyurée, interféron, anagrélide) qui contrôlent les symptômes sans s'attaquer aux cellules qui perpétuent la maladie.

🔹 VÆRIDION (𝑑𝑒́𝑣𝑒𝑙𝑜𝑝𝑝𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑑𝑢 𝑀𝑖𝑐𝑟𝑜𝑙𝑖𝑛𝑒𝑟) — 30 M€ · Série A2.
VÆRIDION a également été sélectionnée pour une subvention de 94,5 M€ du Fonds d'Innovation de la Commission européenne (programme CAROLUS) pour financer une ligne d'assemblage final à Oberpfaffenhofen — subvention conditionnelle à la signature d'un accord attendue en 2027.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Construction du premier prototype conforme, tests de propulsion et de batterie sur banc d'essai, essais en soufflerie.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : SHIFT Invest et Invest-NL (co-leads) ; World Fund, Project A, Vsquared Ventures (existants) ; Alexander Rittweger, fondateur de PAYBACK.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Le montage — fonds propres pour l'ingénierie, subvention publique pour l'industrialisation — est la structure standard des programmes d'avions électriques en Europe, les deux phases ayant des profils de risque et de durée très différents que les financeurs privés ne peuvent pas absorber seuls.

🔹 Green Voltis (𝑜𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑚𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑒𝑡 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑒𝑟𝑐𝑖𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑'𝑎𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑓𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑠𝑡𝑜𝑐𝑘𝑎𝑔𝑒 𝑑'𝑒́𝑛𝑒𝑟𝑔𝑖𝑒 𝑓𝑙𝑒𝑥𝑖𝑏𝑙𝑒 𝑒𝑛 𝐸𝑢𝑟𝑜𝑝𝑒) — 13,5 M€ · Série A.
Green Voltis gère plus de 1,2 GWh de stockage sous contrat et en exploitation.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : Lochpine Capital (investisseur unique).
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Le pivot vers le Power-to-Compute applique la même compétence — prévoir les prix, arbitrer entre marchés, optimiser en temps réel — à un client dont la demande de puissance est structurellement croissante et dont la tolérance à l'imprévisibilité tarifaire est faible.

🔹 ArmorCheck (𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑡𝑟𝑜̂𝑙𝑒 𝑛𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑢𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑓 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑡𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑏𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒𝑠 — 𝑑𝑒́𝑡𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑠 𝑖𝑛𝑡𝑒𝑟𝑛𝑒𝑠 𝑖𝑛𝑣𝑖𝑠𝑖𝑏𝑙𝑒𝑠) — 1 M€.
ArmorCheck a déjà réalisé deux recrutements et prévoit trois embauches supplémentaires en 2027.
